action: Applied deterministic overrides (GDPR Article 22C; AML/KYC Reg. 33 & 35)

details.decision_rationale: The case presents a medium risk rating due to several factors, including a PEP match with a confidence score of 58 and an inconsistent transaction pattern. Although the subject's identity was fully verified and their device reputation is clean, the PEP match and inconsistent transaction pattern require further review. The compliance findings also indicate that the case is GDPR non-compliant because no human is reviewing this case, as the Confidence Score of 80.0 met the threshold of 70. This means Article 22C safeguards are required but not currently in place. The FCA compliance is satisfied due to the detailed analysis providing a clear explanation of the case. Enhanced Due Diligence is required for this case because the PEP match is confirmed, and it has been completed. The combination of these risk signals and compliance findings supports the final recommendation to review the case further.
final_recommendations: Implement Article 22C safeguards to ensure GDPR compliance
Continue to monitor the subject's transaction pattern for any further inconsistencies
